name: key-man-mcp
description: Use locally stored KeyMan credentials from Codex without exposing secret values to the model.

interface.shortDescription: Use local secrets without revealing them to AI.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to the local KeyMan Windows vault. List metadata, copy secrets locally, register from the clipboard or environment, and remove entries without returning secret values through MCP.
interface.defaultPrompt: List the credentials available in KeyMan without exposing any secret values.
